address: 90 Rua de Femão Mendes Pinto, Taipa, Macau
bio: After a spot of renovation for cosier feel, authenticity and hospitality remain the establishment’s hallmark. The friendly owner-chef has revamped the traditional Portuguese menu, now arranged by key ingredient. Using only top-notch seasonal produce, most dishes are barbecued traditionally. Grilled codfish and fried rice with squid ink are the must-tries. Check out the daily specials on the blackboard before ordering....
